definition.def: Emphasis is special or extra importance that is given to an activity or to a part or aspect of something.
examples: Too much emphasis is placed on research. [+ on]
Grant puts a special emphasis on weather in his paintings. [+ on]

definition.def: Emphasis is extra force that you put on a syllable, word, or phrase when you are speaking in order to make it seem more important.
examples: 'I might have known it!' Miss Burnett said with emphasis.
The emphasis is on the first syllable of the last word.
